### Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(Biostrings)
library(httr2)
```

### Paths

```{r}
base_dir <- normalizePath(
  "//wsl.localhost/Ubuntu/home/lucio/projects/CR_pipeline",
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

path_data <- file.path(base_dir, "data")
path_intermediate <- file.path(path_data, "intermediate")
path_processed <- file.path(path_data, "proccesed")
```

### Data import

```{r}
match_data <- read_csv(
  file.path(path_processed, "iedb_match_regions_long_metadata_annotated.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

IEDB_data <- read_csv(
  file.path(path_processed, "iedb_data_with_metadata.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

pathogen_sequences <- read_csv(
  file.path(path_intermediate, "protein_sequences.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

pathogen_occurrences <- read_csv(
  file.path(path_intermediate, "protein_occurrences.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

iedb_fasta <- readAAStringSet(
  file.path(path_intermediate, "matched_iedb_source_proteins.fasta")
)
```

### Helper functions

```{r}
parse_uniprot_id <- function(x) {
  first_token <- x |>
    str_trim() |>
    str_split_i("\\s+", 1) |>
    str_remove("^.*/")

  parsed_id <- if_else(
    str_detect(first_token, fixed("|")),
    str_split_i(first_token, fixed("|"), 2),
    first_token,
    missing = NA_character_
  )

  parsed_id |>
    str_trim() |>
    str_to_upper()
}
```

### Reusable summary tables

```{r}
protein_lengths <- tibble(
  IEDB_Protein_ID = parse_uniprot_id(names(iedb_fasta)),
  Protein_Length = width(iedb_fasta)
) |>
  filter(!is.na(IEDB_Protein_ID)) |>
  distinct()

conflicting_fasta_lengths <- protein_lengths |>
  count(IEDB_Protein_ID) |>
  filter(n > 1)

if (nrow(conflicting_fasta_lengths) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Conflicting FASTA lengths for: ",
    paste(conflicting_fasta_lengths$IEDB_Protein_ID, collapse = ", ")
  )
}
```

### Protein list

```{r}
histone_contaminant_ids <- c(
  "A0AB35K8W1",

)

high_match_iedb_ids <- c(
  "P0DMV8",
```

### Clean identifyers

```{r}
match_data_clean <- match_data |>
  mutate(
    IEDB_Protein_ID = parse_uniprot_id(IEDB_Protein_ID),
    Pathogen_Protein_ID = str_trim(str_to_upper(Pathogen_Protein_ID)),
    Proteome_ID = na_if(str_trim(as.character(Proteome_ID)), "")
  )

# Match_ID is assigned in 4_perfect_match.py.
if (!"Match_ID" %in% names(match_data_clean)) {
  stop("Match_ID is missing. Regenerate the upstream match tables.")
}

if (anyNA(match_data_clean$Match_ID)) {
  stop("Match_ID contains missing values.")
}
```

### Remove histone contaminants

```{r}
match_data_no_histone_contaminants <- match_data_clean |>
  filter(
    !(
      Pathogen_Protein_ID %in% histone_contaminant_ids &
        str_detect(
          coalesce(Epitope_Source, ""),
          regex("histone", ignore_case = TRUE)
        )
    )
  )

histone_filter_audit <- tibble(
  rows_removed =
    nrow(match_data_clean) - nrow(match_data_no_histone_contaminants),
  core_matches_removed =
    n_distinct(match_data_clean$Match_ID) -
      n_distinct(match_data_no_histone_contaminants$Match_ID)
)

histone_filter_audit
```

### Fig 3 Distribution of matched epitopes grouped by source protein and associated disease

```{r}
# Prepare data ------------------------------------------------------------

# Count each core match once per assay and exclude all histone sources.
assay_support <- match_data_no_histone_contaminants |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Assay_ID),
    !is.na(Epitope_Source),
    !is.na(Disease),
    !str_detect(Epitope_Source, regex("histone", ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) |>
  distinct(Assay_ID, Epitope_Source, Disease, Match_ID)

# Order panels by distinct matches across assays.
source_disease_totals <- assay_support |>
  group_by(Epitope_Source, Disease) |>
  summarise(
    total_matches = n_distinct(Match_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

assay_summary <- assay_support |>
  count(
    Assay_ID,
    Epitope_Source,
    Disease,
    name = "n_retained_matches"
  ) |>
  left_join(
    source_disease_totals,
    by = c("Epitope_Source", "Disease")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Epitope_Disease = paste0(Epitope_Source, " (", Disease, ")"),
    Epitope_Disease = fct_reorder(
      Epitope_Disease,
      total_matches,
      .desc = TRUE
    )
  )

# Plot --------------------------------------------------------------------

fig1 <- ggplot(
  assay_summary,
  aes(
    x = n_retained_matches,
    y = reorder(as.character(Assay_ID), n_retained_matches),
    fill = Epitope_Source
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_grid(
    Epitope_Disease ~ .,
    scales = "free_y",
    space = "free_y"
  ) +
  scale_fill_discrete(guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    trans = "log1p",
    breaks = c(0, 1, 10, 100, 1000)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of unique matches (log1p)",
    y = "IEDB assays"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.2, "lines"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.5
    )
  )

fig1
```

### Fig 5 Distribution of epitope matches by pathogen protein subcellular location and rsa.

```{r}
# Prepare data ------------------------------------------------------------

fig3_data <- match_data_no_histone_contaminants |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Assay_ID),
    !is.na(IEDB_Protein_ID),
    !is.na(Pathogen_Organism),
    !is.na(Pathogen_Protein_ID)
  )

match_location_analysis <- fig3_data |>
  filter(!is.na(pathogen_prot_location)) |>
  group_by(
    Assay_ID,
    IEDB_Protein_ID,
    Epitope_Source,
    Disease,
    pathogen_prot_location
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_matches = n_distinct(Match_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Count each match once per assay when calculating mean RSA.
match_rsa_analysis <- fig3_data |>
  filter(between(rsa_pathogen_peptide_mean, 0, 1)) |>
  distinct(
    Assay_ID,
    IEDB_Protein_ID,
    Epitope_Source,
    Disease,
    Match_ID,
    rsa_pathogen_peptide_mean
  ) |>
  group_by(
    Assay_ID,
    IEDB_Protein_ID,
    Epitope_Source,
    Disease
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_matches = n_distinct(Match_ID),
    mean_rsa = mean(rsa_pathogen_peptide_mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Shared theme ------------------------------------------------------------

fig3_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9)
  )

# Panel A: subcellular location --------------------------------------------

p_location <- ggplot(
  match_location_analysis,
  aes(
    x = pathogen_prot_location,
    y = n_matches,
    color = pathogen_prot_location
  )
) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.25,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    ),
    size = 1.8,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    shape = 21,
    fill = NA,
    color = ifelse(
      match_location_analysis$IEDB_Protein_ID %in% high_match_iedb_ids,
      "red",
      "transparent"
    ),
    size = 1.9,
    stroke = 0.5,
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.25,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    ),
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  guides(color = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "A. Match count by pathogen protein location",
    x = "Pathogen protein location",
    y = "Number of unique matches (log10 scale)"
  ) +
  fig3_theme +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

# Panel B: RSA and match count ---------------------------------------------

p_rsa <- ggplot(
  match_rsa_analysis,
  aes(x = mean_rsa, y = n_matches)
) +
  geom_point(
    color = "#2A788E",
    size = 1.8,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = match_rsa_analysis |>
      filter(IEDB_Protein_ID %in% high_match_iedb_ids),
    shape = 21,
    fill = NA,
    color = "red",
    size = 1.9,
    stroke = 0.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "B. Match count and mean pathogen peptide RSA",
    x = "Mean matched-peptide RSA",
    y = "Number of unique matches (log10 scale)"
  ) +
  fig3_theme

# Combine panels ----------------------------------------------------------

fig3 <- (p_location + p_rsa) + plot_layout(guides = "keep")
fig3
```

### Figure S1 Distribution of total amino acid content per pathogen species in the pathogen protein dataset

```{r}
# Prepare data ------------------------------------------------------------

pathogen_lengths <- pathogen_sequences |>
  transmute(
    Protein_ID = str_trim(str_to_upper(Protein_ID)),
    protein_len = str_length(Sequence)
  )

# Each protein contributes once per proteome occurrence.
species_aa_summary <- pathogen_occurrences |>
  transmute(
    Protein_ID = str_trim(str_to_upper(Protein_ID)),
    Proteome_ID = na_if(str_trim(as.character(Proteome_ID)), ""),
    Organism_Source = Genus_species
  ) |>
  left_join(pathogen_lengths, by = "Protein_ID") |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Organism_Source),
    Organism_Source != "",
    !is.na(protein_len)
  ) |>
  group_by(Organism_Source) |>
  summarise(
    AA_len = sum(protein_len),
    n_proteomes = n_distinct(Proteome_ID),
    n_protein_occurrences = n(),
    n_unique_protein_ids = n_distinct(Protein_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(AA_len))

# Shared theme ------------------------------------------------------------

figs1_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
  )

# Panel A: distribution across species -------------------------------------

p1 <- ggplot(species_aa_summary, aes(x = AA_len)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 30,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    labels = scales::label_number(
      scale = 1e-6,
      accuracy = 0.1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Total amino acids per species (millions, log10 scale)",
    y = "Number of species"
  ) +
  figs1_theme

# Panel B: species with the largest totals ---------------------------------

p2 <- species_aa_summary |>
  slice_max(AA_len, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = reorder(Organism_Source, AA_len),
      y = AA_len,
      fill = n_proteomes
    )
  ) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-6)
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "D") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Organism",
    y = "Total amino acids (millions)",
    fill = "Number of proteomes"
  ) +
  figs1_theme

# Combine panels ----------------------------------------------------------

figs1 <- p1 + p2 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
figs1
```

### Figure S2. Distribution of epitope per source protein in IEDB data.

```{r}
# Prepare data ------------------------------------------------------------

epitope_source_summary <- IEDB_data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Protein_source),
    Protein_source != ""
  ) |>
  group_by(Epitope_Source = Protein_source) |>
  summarise(
    n_epitopes = n_distinct(
      Protein_ID,
      Sequence,
      epitope_start_pos,
      epitope_end_pos
    ),
    diseases = paste(
      sort(unique(Disease[!is.na(Disease) & Disease != ""])),
      collapse = ", "
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Epitope_Disease = if_else(
      diseases == "",
      Epitope_Source,
      paste0(Epitope_Source, "\n(", diseases, ")")
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n_epitopes))

# Shared theme ------------------------------------------------------------

figs2_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black")
  )

# Panel A: source proteins with the most epitopes ---------------------------

p_top15 <- epitope_source_summary |>
  slice_max(n_epitopes, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = reorder(Epitope_Disease, n_epitopes),
      y = n_epitopes
    )
  ) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue", color = "black") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = "Epitope source protein",
    y = "Number of unique epitopes"
  ) +
  figs2_theme

# Panel B: distribution across source proteins -----------------------------

p_hist <- ggplot(
  epitope_source_summary,
  aes(x = n_epitopes)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 5,
    boundary = 0,
    fill = "steelblue",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of unique epitopes per source protein",
    y = "Number of source proteins"
  ) +
  figs2_theme

# Combine panels ----------------------------------------------------------

figs2 <- p_top15 + p_hist +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1.4, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

figs2
```

### Fig S4. Tissue specificity of matched IEDB source proteins

```{r}
# Prepare match counts ----------------------------------------------------

iedb_protein_matches <- match_data_no_histone_contaminants |>
  filter(
    !is.na(IEDB_Protein_ID),
    !is.na(Epitope_Source),
    !str_detect(Epitope_Source, regex("histone", ignore_case = TRUE))
  ) |>
  group_by(Epitope_Source, IEDB_Protein_ID) |>
  summarise(
    n_matches_prot = n_distinct(Match_ID),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Retrieve tissue-specificity scores ---------------------------------------

get_hpa_tau <- function(id) {
  tryCatch(
    {
      dat <- request(
        "https://www.proteinatlas.org/api/search_download.php"
      ) |>
        req_url_query(
          search = id,
          format = "json",
          columns = "up,t_RNA__tau",
          compress = "no"
        ) |>
        req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
        req_perform() |>
        resp_body_json(simplifyVector = TRUE)

      tibble(
        IEDB_Protein_ID = id,
        tau_tissue = as.numeric(dat[["TAU score - Tissue"]])[1]
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("HPA query failed for ", id, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
      tibble(
        IEDB_Protein_ID = id,
        tau_tissue = NA_real_
      )
    }
  )
}

hpa_results <- iedb_protein_matches |>
  left_join(
    map_dfr(unique(iedb_protein_matches$IEDB_Protein_ID), get_hpa_tau),
    by = "IEDB_Protein_ID"
  )

# Report proteins without a score.
hpa_results |>
  filter(is.na(tau_tissue)) |>
  select(Epitope_Source, IEDB_Protein_ID)

# Plot --------------------------------------------------------------------

figs4_data <- hpa_results |>
  filter(!is.na(tau_tissue))

figs4 <- ggplot(
  figs4_data,
  aes(x = tau_tissue, y = n_matches_prot)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = Epitope_Source),
    size = 2.7,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 123
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    x = "RNA tissue specificity (Tau score)",
    y = "Number of unique core matches (log10 scale)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

figs4
```

### epitope len and matches plot

```{r}
matched <- match_data_clean |>
  mutate(epitope_len = str_length(IEDB_Epitope_Sequence)) |>
  summarise(N_matches = n_distinct(Match_ID),
            .by = c(Assay_ID, epitope_len))

all_epitopes <- IEDB_data |>
  mutate(epitope_len = str_length(Sequence)) |>
  distinct(Assay_ID, epitope_len) |>
  left_join(matched, by = c("Assay_ID", "epitope_len")) |>
  mutate(N_matches = coalesce(N_matches, 0L))

make_plots <- function(dat, title) {
  means <- dat |>
    summarise(N_matches = mean(N_matches), .by = epitope_len)

  label <- function(d) {
    fit <- lm(N_matches ~ epitope_len, d)
    sprintf("Slope = %.3f\nR² = %.3f",
            coef(fit)[2], summary(fit)$r.squared)
  }

  common <- list(
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = "red"),
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_width(1)),
    theme_classic()
  )

  list(
    raw = ggplot(dat, aes(epitope_len, N_matches)) +
      geom_jitter(width = 0.01, height = 0, alpha = 0.5) +
      annotate("text", Inf, Inf, label = label(dat),
               hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2) +
      common +
      labs(title = title, x = "Epitope length",
           y = "Number of matches per assay"),

    mean = ggplot(means, aes(epitope_len, N_matches)) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      annotate("text", Inf, Inf, label = label(means),
               hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.2) +
      common +
      labs(title = paste(title, "— means"), x = "Epitope length",
           y = "Mean number of matches per assay")
  )
}

all_plots     <- make_plots(all_epitopes, "All epitopes")
matched_plots <- make_plots(matched, "Matched epitopes")

all_plots$raw
all_plots$mean
matched_plots$raw
matched_plots$mean
```

### proportion of epitopes in protein that matched and didnt

```{r}
# Prepare eligible IEDB epitopes -------------------------------------------

epitope_keys <- c(
  "IEDB_Protein_ID",
  "Epitope_Sequence",
  "Epitope_Start",
  "Epitope_End"
)

# Match step 4's requirement for valid start and end coordinates.
eligible_epitopes <- IEDB_data |>
  transmute(
    IEDB_Protein_ID = parse_uniprot_id(Protein_ID),
    Epitope_Source = Protein_source,
    Epitope_Sequence = Sequence,
    Epitope_Start = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(as.character(epitope_start_pos))
    ),
    Epitope_End = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(as.character(epitope_end_pos))
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(IEDB_Protein_ID),
    !is.na(Epitope_Source),
    Epitope_Source != "",
    !is.na(Epitope_Sequence),
    !is.na(Epitope_Start),
    !is.na(Epitope_End)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Epitope_Start = as.integer(Epitope_Start),
    Epitope_End = as.integer(Epitope_End)
  ) |>
  distinct()

# Identify epitopes with at least one retained match ------------------------

matched_epitope_keys <- match_data_no_histone_contaminants |>
  transmute(
    IEDB_Protein_ID = parse_uniprot_id(IEDB_Protein_ID),
    Epitope_Sequence = IEDB_Epitope_Sequence,
    Epitope_Start = as.integer(as.character(Epitope_Start)),
    Epitope_End = as.integer(as.character(Epitope_End))
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  mutate(has_match = TRUE)

epitope_match_status <- eligible_epitopes |>
  left_join(matched_epitope_keys, by = epitope_keys) |>
  mutate(has_match = replace_na(has_match, FALSE))

# Calculate counts within each source -------------------------------------

source_match_summary <- epitope_match_status |>
  group_by(Epitope_Source) |>
  summarise(
    n_matched = sum(has_match),
    n_unmatched = sum(!has_match),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Epitope_Source = fct_reorder(Epitope_Source, n_matched)
  )

source_match_plot_data <- source_match_summary |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_unmatched, n_matched),
    names_to = "match_status",
    values_to = "count"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    signed_count = if_else(
      match_status == "n_unmatched",
      -count,
      count
    ),
    match_status = factor(
      match_status,
      levels = c("n_unmatched", "n_matched"),
      labels = c("Unmatched", "Matched")
    )
  )

# Plot --------------------------------------------------------------------

fig_epitope_match_source <- ggplot(
  source_match_plot_data,
  aes(
    x = signed_count,
    y = Epitope_Source,
    fill = match_status
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = function(limits) {
      seq(
        floor(limits[1] / 5) * 5,
        ceiling(limits[2] / 5) * 5,
        by = 5
      )
    },
    labels = function(x) abs(x),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Unmatched" = "#B8B8B8",
      "Matched" = "#2A788E"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Number of epitopes",
    y = "Epitope source protein",
    fill = NULL,
    subtitle = "Unmatched \u2190                 \u2192 Matched"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

fig_epitope_match_source
```

### RSA comparison between matched and unmatched epitopes

```{r}
# Prepare unique epitopes with full-epitope RSA ----------------------------

rsa_epitopes <- IEDB_data |>
  transmute(
    IEDB_Protein_ID = parse_uniprot_id(Protein_ID),
    Epitope_Sequence = Sequence,
    Epitope_Start = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(as.character(epitope_start_pos))
    ),
    Epitope_End = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(as.character(epitope_end_pos))
    ),
    rsa_epitope_mean = suppressWarnings(
      as.numeric(as.character(rsa_epitope_mean))
    )
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(IEDB_Protein_ID),
    !is.na(Epitope_Sequence),
    !is.na(Epitope_Start),
    !is.na(Epitope_End),
    between(rsa_epitope_mean, 0, 1)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Epitope_Start = as.integer(Epitope_Start),
    Epitope_End = as.integer(Epitope_End)
  ) |>
  distinct()

# Assign matched/unmatched status ----------------------------------------

epitope_rsa_comparison <- rsa_epitopes |>
  left_join(
    matched_epitope_keys,
    by = epitope_keys
  ) |>
  mutate(
    has_match = replace_na(has_match, FALSE),
    match_status = factor(
      if_else(has_match, "Matched", "Unmatched"),
      levels = c("Unmatched", "Matched")
    )
  )

# Compare RSA between groups ----------------------------------------------

rsa_test <- wilcox.test(
  rsa_epitope_mean ~ match_status,
  data = epitope_rsa_comparison,
  exact = FALSE
)

rsa_p_label <- paste0(
  "Wilcoxon p ",
  format.pval(rsa_test$p.value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)
)

# Plot --------------------------------------------------------------------

fig_rsa_matched_unmatched <- ggplot(
  epitope_rsa_comparison,
  aes(
    x = rsa_epitope_mean,
    y = match_status,
    color = match_status
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0.4,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0,
      height = 0.15,
      seed = 123
    ),
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.98,
    y = 1.5,
    label = rsa_p_label,
    hjust = 1,
    size = 4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Unmatched" = "#888888",
      "Matched" = "#2A788E"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean full-epitope RSA",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black")
  )

fig_rsa_matched_unmatched
```

```{r}
selected_sources <- c(
  "Endoplasmic reticulum chaperone BiP",
  "Heat shock 70 kDa protein 1A",
  "60 kDa heat shock protein, mitochondria",
  "Alpha-enolase",
  "Stress-70 protein, mitochondrial"
)

cytoplasmic_pct_by_source <- fig3_data |>
  filter(
    !is.na(Epitope_Source),
    !is.na(pathogen_prot_location)
  ) |>
  # Prevent assay duplication from counting the same match repeatedly
  distinct(
    Epitope_Source,
    Match_ID,
    pathogen_prot_location
  ) |>
  group_by(Epitope_Source) |>
  summarise(
    n_matches_with_location = n_distinct(Match_ID),
    n_cytoplasmic_matches = n_distinct(
      Match_ID[
        str_to_lower(pathogen_prot_location) == "cytoplasmic"
      ]
    ),
    pct_cytoplasmic = (
      100 * n_cytoplasmic_matches / n_matches_with_location
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    protein_group = case_when(
      Epitope_Source %in% selected_sources ~
        "Selected five proteins",

      str_detect(
        Epitope_Source,
        regex("histone", ignore_case = TRUE)
      ) ~ NA_character_,

      TRUE ~ "Other non-histone proteins"
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(protein_group))

cytoplasmic_group_stats <- cytoplasmic_pct_by_source |>
  group_by(protein_group) |>
  summarise(
    n_source_proteins = n(),
    mean_pct = mean(pct_cytoplasmic),
    sd_pct = sd(pct_cytoplasmic),
    minimum_pct = min(pct_cytoplasmic),
    q1_pct = quantile(pct_cytoplasmic, 0.25),
    median_pct = median(pct_cytoplasmic),
    q3_pct = quantile(pct_cytoplasmic, 0.75),
    maximum_pct = max(pct_cytoplasmic),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 2))
  )

cytoplasmic_group_stats
```
